info.name: Autocare assessment policy monthly settlement and business dashboard

exec: if(pm.variables.get("isolated_assessment_cases")!=="true"){pm.execution.skipRequest();throw new Error("Use the isolated fulfillment runner");}

pm.test("business 1",()=>{const d=pm.response.json().data;pm.expect(d.merchant).to.eql({id:2,name:"synthetic other shop",address:"synthetic address"});pm.expect(d.source_note).to.eql("合成考核政策");pm.expect(d.process_requirements).to.eql(["CHECK_IN_CONFIRMED","REPORT_SUBMITTED"]);pm.expect(d.grade_thresholds[0].code).to.eql("A");});
